PSIM Yogyakarta vs Persik Kediri: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Indonesian Super League match, in which top-flight newcomer PSIM Yogyakarta hosts the solid mid-table side, Persik Kediri. For the hosts, who are in a relegation battle, this is a crucial home game, while the visitors aim to solidify their position in the top half of the table.

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK)
Stadium: Mandala Krida Stadium, Yogyakarta
Competition: Indonesia Super League

PSIM vs Persik Kediri: Match Preview

This is a showdown between a team with one of the most passionate fanbases in Indonesia and a more experienced, higher-quality opponent. PSIM, having returned to the elite division, is relying on its home matches where the team is transformed by the deafening support from the stands. Persik Kediri is known for its technical and attacking football but is not always consistent on the road. The history of meetings between these clubs points to the competitive nature of their rivalry, although recent official matches have gone Persik's way.

Team Form and Analysis

PSIM Yogyakarta

The 'Mataram Warriors' (Laskar Mataram) have expectedly faced difficulties in the Super League. The team is in the lower part of the table, and its main problem is a weak attack. However, at their Mandala Krida stadium, PSIM has lost only once this season, relying on a tight defense and quick counter-attacks. The support of the fans will be a key factor for the hosts.

Persik Kediri

The 'White Tigers' (Macan Putih) are an experienced Super League competitor. The team shows a good balance between the lines and has quality foreign players in attack, such as Brazilian forward Flávio Silva. Persik secured a victory in the last round and will be looking to build on that success. The visitors will likely dominate possession and try to break down the deep-lying defense of the league newcomers.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • PSIM (5-4-1): Huda; Jaya, Nugroho, Dewangga, Arhan, Sanadi; Setiawan, Zola, Lilipaly, Maulana; Laukik.
  • Persik Kediri (4-2-3-1): Dikri; Agil, Hehanusa, Vava, Lyngbo; Renan Silva, Taufiq; Supriadi, Pahabol, Flávio Silva; Jefinho.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Persik Kediri is the favorite due to their higher class and experience. However, the incredible support from the crowd and PSIM's resilience at home could cause serious problems for the visitors.

  • Main Prediction: Persik Kediri Double Chance (X2). The visitors are a class above, but the factor of an away match in Yogyakarta makes a draw a very likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. PSIM will play strictly from the defense, and Persik will find it difficult to break down their packed defense. Statistics also point to low-scoring affairs in their matches.

Persija Jakarta vs PSBS Biak: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Indonesian Super League match, in which one of the country's most decorated and popular clubs, Persija Jakarta, hosts the absolute top-flight debutant, PSBS Biak. This is the first-ever meeting between these teams, with crucial points at stake for clubs from opposite ends of the league table. [1, 2]

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK)
Stadium: Patriot Chandrabhaga Stadium, Bekasi
Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persija vs PSBS Biak: Match Preview

Persija Jakarta enters the match as the undisputed favorite. The 'Kemayoran Tigers' are in the hunt for the top spots and are traditionally powerful with the backing of their huge fanbase. [1] For PSBS Biak, who sensationally won Liga 2 last season to earn their first-ever promotion to the top flight, every match is a battle for survival. The team is in the lower part of the table and has shown poor results, especially away from home. [2]

Team Form and Analysis

Persija Jakarta

The capital's giant is showing consistent results, especially in home matches. The team focuses on ball possession and combination play. Persija's attacking line, featuring stars like Marko Šimić and Ryo Matsumura, is one of the strongest in the league. Against the newcomers, the 'Tigers' will aim to dominate from the first minute and secure a comfortable victory. [1]

PSBS Biak

The team from Papua has expectedly faced difficulties at the new level. PSBS Biak is in the relegation zone, with their main problem being poor performance in away matches. [2] Away to one of the giants, the team will likely opt for a deep defensive tactic, relying on set pieces and the sheer determination of its players.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persija (4-3-3): Andritany; Rio, Kúdela, Ferarri, Birrul; Gajos, Hannan, Fajar; Riko, Šimić, Matsumura.
  • PSBS Biak (5-4-1): Mariño; Rumpik, César, Tjo-A-On, Pae, Sanadi; Tahay, Manutoy, Kaka, Betu; Alex.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class, experience, and player quality between the two teams is colossal. Persija, on their home ground, should not face any problems against one of the underdogs. [1, 2]

  • Main Prediction: Persija Jakarta to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The 'Kemayoran Tigers' should comfortably defeat the debutant by a margin of at least two goals. [2]
  • Total Goals Prediction: Persija to Win to Nil. The hosts' powerful attack and the visitors' likely weak offensive display make a clean-sheet victory for Persija the most probable outcome. [1]

Al Hilal vs Al Shabab: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the central match of the Saudi Pro League round – the Riyadh derby, where Al Hilal hosts Al Shabab at the Kingdom Arena. This is a clash between teams with different fortunes at the start of the season: the hosts are fighting for the championship title from the top three, while the visitors are in mid-table showing inconsistent results.

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 14:50 UTC (17:50 MSK)
Stadium: Kingdom Arena, Riyadh
Competition: Saudi Pro League

Al Hilal vs Al Shabab: Match Preview

Al Hilal approaches the derby in superb form, boasting a seven-match winning streak across all competitions and remaining undefeated this season. Simone Inzaghi's side has demonstrated a potent attack, scoring 17 goals, and a solid defense, conceding just 6 in the league. Al Shabab, in contrast, is struggling, with only one win in their opening six rounds. The head-to-head history is overwhelmingly in Al Hilal's favor: 'The Leaders' have won 26 of the last 51 matches, while Al Shabab has been victorious only 9 times. Al Hilal has not lost to Al Shabab at home since 2014.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Hilal

The reigning champions and league leaders are at the peak of their form. The team plays balanced and dominant football. The attacking line, featuring stars like Neymar, Aleksandar Mitrović, and Malcom, is one of the strongest in Asia. In their last four matches, Al Hilal has conceded only one goal, securing three clean sheets. The hosts have some personnel losses, with João Cancelo and Salem Al-Dawsari injured.

Al Shabab

The 'White Lions' are going through a difficult period. Despite a recent King's Cup victory over a lower-division team, the team is struggling to find its rhythm in the league. They have become more pragmatic, with five consecutive league matches seeing under 3.5 goals. However, they have issues in attack, evidenced by only 5 goals scored in 6 games. The visitors also have injury concerns, including forward Abderrazak Hamdallah.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Hilal (4-2-3-1): Bono; Abdulhamid, Koulibaly, Al-Bulaihi, Hernández; Neves, Milinković-Savić; Malcom, Neymar, Leonardo; Núñez.
  • Al Shabab (4-5-1): Grohe; Al-Ghulaimish, Hoedt, Al-Shwirekh, Balobaid; Sierro, Brownhill, Hernández, Adli, Carrasco; Al-Othman.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Al Hilal is the undisputed favorite for this derby. Their current form, dominance in head-to-head encounters, and Al Shabab's attacking struggles make a home win the most likely outcome.

  • Main Prediction: Al Hilal to Win. 'The Leaders' should confidently secure three points in the home derby.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 3.5 Goals. Al Shabab has been playing low-scoring football recently, and this total has not been breached in three of the last five head-to-head meetings at Al Hilal's ground.

Kudrivka vs Obolon': Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a crucial match in the Ukrainian Premier League relegation battle, as part of Matchday 12. Top-flight debutant Kudrivka hosts Obolon' Kyiv at their home ground. This is a classic 'six-pointer' between direct competitors from the bottom of the league table.

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK)
Stadium: Kudrivka-Arena, Kudrivka
Competition: Ukrainian Premier League, Matchday 12

Kudrivka vs Obolon': Match Preview

Both teams approach the match with one goal - to earn vital points to move away from the relegation zone. Kudrivka, in their first UPL season, will aim to use their home-field advantage to overcome a direct rival. Obolon', a more experienced fighter in relegation battles, is known for its resilient character and organized defense. The match promises to be tense, gritty, and full of physical battles.

Team Form and Analysis

Kudrivka

The debutant from the Chernihiv region has expectedly faced difficulties at the top level. The team relies on commitment and a tight defensive game but has serious problems with creating and converting chances, making them one of the lowest-scoring teams in the league. A home victory against a direct competitor could be a key moment for Kudrivka in their fight for survival.

Obolon'

The 'Brewers,' under the management of Valeriy Ivashchenko, play a pragmatic style of football. The team rarely suffers heavy defeats, knows how to grind out results, and imposes an uncomfortable, physical style on their opponents. Obolon's main problem is a lack of creativity in attack, which is why the team also scores very few goals. In an away match against a similarly defensive opponent, the 'Brewers' would likely be content with a draw.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Kudrivka (5-4-1): Sledzevskyi; Hahun, Kortes, Berezanskyi, Sydorenko, Mykhailenko; Vechurko, Skepskyi, Zhykol, Kulyk; Koval.
  • Obolon' (5-4-1): Rybka; Prokopenko, Karas, Pryimak, Lukianchuk, Osman; Medynskyi, Moroz, Chernenko, Hrusha; Krasnopir.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A typical 'six-pointer' is expected - a nervous game with minimal risks and scoring chances. The outcome could be decided by a single goal or a set-piece.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a battle between two evenly matched underdogs where the cost of defeat is extremely high, a draw seems the most likely result.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Two teams with serious attacking problems, both playing a defensive style, are unlikely to treat fans to a goal fest.

Getafe vs Girona: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the opening match of the 11th round of the Spanish La Liga, where Getafe hosts Girona at their home ground, the Coliseum. This is a clash between a mid-table team and one of the main relegation candidates, currently sitting in last place.

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK)
Stadium: Coliseum, Getafe
Competition: La Liga, Matchday 11

Getafe vs Girona: Match Preview

Getafe comes into the match in 10th place with 14 points, playing a pragmatic yet effective style of football. Girona, in contrast, is having a disastrous season, sitting in 20th place with just 7 points and having failed to win 11 of their last 12 La Liga matches. Both teams secured victories in the Copa del Rey during the week: Getafe thrashed Inter de Valdemoro 11-0, while Girona narrowly beat Constancia 3-2 in extra time. The head-to-head history at Getafe's ground favors the hosts, who have won three of the last four encounters at the Coliseum.

Team Form and Analysis

Getafe

José Bordalás's team remains true to its defensive style, which is especially evident in home matches. All four games at the Coliseum this season have seen under 2.5 goals. Despite some overall inconsistency, recent wins in the cup and a 1-0 league victory over Athletic Club should boost the team's confidence.

Girona

The Catalans are in a deep crisis. The team has been very poor on the road, scoring only 3 goals in four away La Liga matches. Girona also has serious defensive problems, which has led to their last-place position in the table. A cup victory over a lower-tier team is hardly an indicator that they have overcome their crisis.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Getafe (4-4-2): Soria; Suárez, Djené, Alderete, Rico; Greenwood, Maksimović, Milla, Mata; Mayoral, Latasa.
  • Girona (4-2-3-1): Gazzaniga; Couto, Eric García, Blind, Gutiérrez; Aleix García, Herrera; Tsyhankov, Martín, Sávio; Stuani.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Given Girona's dreadful form, especially away from home, and Getafe's traditionally tough-to-beat nature on their own turf, the hosts are clear favorites.

  • Main Prediction: Getafe to Win. The 'Azulones' are in better form and should confidently defeat the league's main underdog at home.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Getafe concedes and scores very few goals at home, while Girona has been extremely unproductive on the road.

Sporting CP vs Alverca: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Portuguese Primeira Liga Matchday 9 fixture, in which Sporting CP hosts Alverca at the Estádio José Alvalade. This is a showdown between one of the leaders and main title contenders against a team that has returned to the top flight and is fighting for survival.

Kick-off: October 31, 2025, 20:15 UTC (23:15 MSK)
Stadium: Estádio José Alvalade, Lisbon
Competition: Primeira Liga, Matchday 9

Sporting CP vs Alverca: Match Preview

Sporting comes into the match as the undisputed favorite. The 'Lions,' under the management of Rúben Amorim, play the most exciting and high-scoring football in Portugal, leading the league table. Alverca, in turn, is in the lower part of the table and is in desperate need of points to move away from the relegation zone. The head-to-head history is entirely on the side of Sporting, who have won the majority of their encounters, although the last cup meeting between the teams in 2019 sensationally ended in a 2-0 victory for Alverca.

Team Form and Analysis

Sporting CP

The Lisbon side is in superb form, securing victories in both the league and European competitions. The team has the most potent attack in the league, with Swedish forward Viktor Gyökeres shining as the top scorer. At home, Sporting rarely drops points and will be looking for another convincing victory in front of their fans.

Alverca

Since returning to the top flight, Alverca has struggled to adapt to the higher level. The team relies on organized defense and commitment but lacks quality in attack. In an away match against the league leader, Alverca will undoubtedly opt for a deep 'park-the-bus' defensive tactic, hoping for rare counter-attacks and set pieces. Containing the mighty attack of the 'Lions' will be a nearly impossible task for them.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Sporting CP (3-4-3): Adán; Diomande, Coates, Inácio; Esgaio, Hjulmand, Morita, Santos; Edwards, Gyökeres, Gonçalves.
  • Alverca (5-4-1): Cabral; Monteiro, Furtado, Bruno, Silva, Miguel; Pereira, Gonçalo, Martins, Afonso; Duarte.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class, current form, and ambitions between the teams is colossal. Sporting, on their home ground, should not face any problems against one of the league's underdogs.

  • Main Prediction: Sporting CP to Win with a (-2.5) Handicap. The 'Lions' are in too good of an attacking form and should comfortably defeat such an opponent.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Sporting scores a lot, especially at home, and it is unlikely that Alverca will be able to withstand their pressure.
